Enum Class AttributeType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AttributeType>
com.github.pinont.singularitylib.api.enums.AttributeType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<AttributeType>, Constable
public enum AttributeType extends Enum<AttributeType>
Enumeration of attribute types available in the game. Each attribute type represents a specific characteristic that can be applied to entities.
